intro: Tourism and financial services are the pillars of Barbados's economy.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Tourism is the biggest industry. Rum and sugar are traditional exports; Barbados claims to be the birthplace of rum.

chapters.title: Services
text: International business and finance are growing.
